notes: This suite verifies independent skill routing, not a cross-skill workflow.
No scenario may require plugin onboarding, shared state, issue graphs, reservations, or phase handoffs.
Treat plugin-eval static score as structural evidence; scenario outcomes determine behavioral correctness.

scenarios.title: Prompt upgrade
scenarios.purpose: Check whether a weak prompt is strengthened without executing the underlying task.
scenarios.userInput: Improve this prompt for an AI coding agent, but do not execute it: Make the API faster.
mustNot: Do not invent a mandatory cross-skill workflow.
Do not change the user's underlying objective.
successChecklist: The result adds a measurable objective or asks for the missing measurement context.
The result includes proportional verification and done criteria.
The underlying API task is not executed.

scenarios.title: Goal grilling
scenarios.purpose: Check whether a vague autonomous objective is clarified before a final goal is produced.
scenarios.userInput: Use goal mode to improve onboarding in this repository. Grill me first and do not start the goal yet.
mustNot: Do not create or start a goal.
Do not ask several generic questions at once.
Do not finalize a goal while success evidence remains undefined.
successChecklist: The run restates the apparent intent.
The run asks exactly one high-leverage question.
The question includes a recommended answer and concrete reason.

scenarios.title: Research before implementation
scenarios.purpose: Check whether unfamiliar feature work starts from repo evidence and current sources.
scenarios.userInput: Research how passkeys should be added to this repository. Map the actual stack, local reuse, upstream patterns, and current official docs. Do not implement.
mustNot: Do not guess the stack from memory.
Do not blur local evidence, upstream patterns, docs, and inference.
successChecklist: The run inspects local repository evidence before external research.
The run notices when the repository does not contain the assumed application surface.
The result labels evidence and recommends the lightest credible next step.

scenarios.title: Priority versus execution order
scenarios.purpose: Check whether the plan preserves urgent outcomes while scheduling proven prerequisites honestly.
scenarios.userInput: Create an execution plan. P0: stop duplicate charges. P2: add idempotency storage, which the durable fix needs. Duplicate charges are happening now, and a reversible payment pause is available today.
mustNot: Do not close or downgrade the P0 because a P2 executes first.
Do not call the payment pause a durable resolution.
Do not order work by labels alone.
successChecklist: The plan separates mitigation from durable resolution.
The sequence explains payment pause, idempotency storage, durable fix, validation, and cleanup through cause and effect.
The P0 remains open until its acceptance evidence is satisfied.

scenarios.title: tldraw API automation
scenarios.purpose: Check whether an installed tldraw app is scripted through its authenticated local API instead of mouse automation.
scenarios.userInput: Create a new tldraw file showing Client -> API -> Database. Use the installed app's APIs, bind the arrows, save the file, and verify the result without Computer Use.
mustNot: Do not expose or hardcode the local bearer token.
Do not hardcode a hashed renderer module filename or export key.
Do not use mouse-driven Computer Use when the Canvas API is available.
successChecklist: The run discovers the active document and API state dynamically.
The two semantic arrows have start and end bindings.
The saved file is reopened or otherwise verified through shapes, bindings, lint, and a screenshot.

scenarios.title: No skill for a trivial transformation
scenarios.purpose: Check whether the plugin avoids unnecessary ceremony.
scenarios.userInput: Return only this list alphabetized: beta, alpha, gamma.
successChecklist: The run returns alpha, beta, gamma in order.
The run performs no tool calls or workspace edits.
